items.title: Ben Sidran interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 15, 2023
items.q: The worst gig I ever played was as the opening act for Rodney Dangerfield... I’m going to go play my opening set as Ben Sidran but then I’m going to come back out on stage as the piano player “Styles Bitchley”... and play behind him.

ctx.x: Likewise, thank you very much. I’ll just pause this and we’ll have our good-byes. So we’re back for a little addendum. And the question was the fact that I often ask what’s the worst gig you ever played and I guess you had one?

Yes. The worst gig I ever played was as the opening act for Rodney Dangerfield. It was at a theater in Tucson, Arizona. And Rodney of course, being a Las Vegas comic, often worked with jazz musicians. And so the promoter thought oh this will be great — you know Ben’s kind of a hipster and Rodney is a hipster and we’ll put them together and it’s great. Well Rodney had just done this movie “Caddyshack” and been on the cover of Rolling Stone. So in the time between when the gig was booked and the gig actually…
